blocks.h: Cut off at the output limit

blocks.p: 0 0 of 1,998 decisions sent an output limit; 0 over 32,768 output tokens without one
local (reax13 serve.py) reax/reax13 · effort not in the requests

A late entry joins an original league table after it was played and plays every setup of that table once, in matches of its own. Its games count in no standings table, no league table, no Hype Cup input and no other setup's numbers. The numbers here come from its own late-entry games only, computed as for a setup in a league.

Error rate and risk judgement: 95% intervals, whole games resampled. Ability d′ and caution c at the 0.001 margin: rates corrected by adding 0.5 to the counts and 1 to the totals; 95% intervals, blocks of two seat-swapped games resampled. Cut off: answers that stopped at an output limit the request sent (finish reason length, stop reason max_tokens, finishReason MAX_TOKENS, incomplete max_output_tokens), in the stored response or error. Effort: the reasoning effort the requests sent. Engine's best play: the share of its scored decisions that chose the engine's best play (equity loss under the best-play threshold). Time: median request seconds per decision (waits between retries not included). Cost per 1,000 decisions: the recorded tokens at the price shown, as labelled there (list or billed price; for a setup on our GPUs the hosted model's list price, not billed).

blocks.p: decisionmodels/REAX-1.3 @ fa4bf7ee3bb56a8bc421dad090631be1c5845c2d (Hugging Face, Apache-2.0; two parts in FP8 on one GPU)

NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB), in Docker, through reax-engine (github.com/reaxlabs/reax-engine @ ff8f595f149abdd50ea914455eadc74cf97a277f, reax13 mode, its serve.py), one request at a time, no outside network
no price per token; estimate: GPU time, at most; source content/own_cost.json (wall clock on our machines × hourly rate); price date not recorded

up to 255 options per request (the server's limit, from the model card); more legal plays are split into equal groups, a winner per group, then among the winners; in this data 1 decisions were split into groups of 163

Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 7 Nov 2026. Each option's probability is the 50/50 mean of the two parts' probabilities, stored as returned; in the smoke test before the run every probability sum was 1.000000. Its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played: GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit; the pair is outside the requested scope (Ümit, 12 Nov). Run note: the server's container ran without Docker's no-new-privileges setting, approved for this run only (the host's Docker refused every container with it); every other protection was kept: all capabilities dropped, read-only root filesystem, non-root user, weights mounted read-only, no outside network.
